decisions.evidence: Balancing these factors, the molecule looks borderline but ultimately more consistent with BBB penetration than not, mainly because its molecular weight is low, it has good drug-likeness, and it retains a lipophilic aromatic scaffold. The main drawback is the low neutral fraction together with the amine, but the overall profile still supports option (B): crosses the BBB.
